items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: Joe Smith was the same thing, was playin' sweet, cool jazz, I would say.

ctx.x: Joe Smith was the same thing, was playin' sweet, cool jazz, I would say. And he didn't sound like Louis Armstrong.

Right, the point I was trying to get at is that would you liken this New York kind of pre-Bechet-Armstrong kind of sound of jazz that you heard a few years later - was it similar to the music you, that Miller and Polk's bands were playing in the Philadelphia area? Were there people like that or was it completely different?
